newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Treasury says to study 30-yr bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Spain Treasury says to study 30-yr bond issues.

text.p: The Spanish Treasury will study in the fourth quarter the possibility of issuing 30-year bonds to complete its spectrum of debt instruments, Treasury General Director Jaime Caruana said.
"In the fourth quarter we are going to study the possibility of issuing 30-year bonds," Caruana said in an interview with financial daily Gaceta de Negocios published on Monday.
The Treasury introduced 18-month bills, and strips earlier this year. Its longest bond has a 15-year maturity.
"With this and the strips we think that we have the entire battery of financing instruments," Caruana said.
